messages:
Sara (docs): Quick heads-up — opened a tiny PR to convert the tiered usage + quota examples from the old header flow to the v2 metering pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/5123. Can folks scan for: header name, example payload, and dashboard link?
Alex M: Looking now. One quick thing: the example still shows \`X-Usage-Plan: pro\` in the snippet — v2 should be using the JSON body or \`x-rw-usage\` header. Which canonical do we want? :eyes:
Miguel (eng-ml): We standardized on \`X-Redwood-Usage\` for the SDK+HTTP shim, but the canonical docs should show the JSON meter payload (best practice). Header is fine as a quick example but must match examples in SDK snippets.
Sara (docs): Ok — I'll replace the header with the JSON meter payload and add a short note that SDKs will set \`X-Redwood-Usage\` for you. Suggestion for wording: "Send a single metering object in the request body (preferred). For direct HTTP integrations, you may alternatively include the \`X-Redwood-Usage\` header." Good?
Emily (product): Sounds right. Also can we clarify the tier math example? There's a line that says "100k tokens => tier 2" which is outdated after the recent tier changes. Replace with the new banding: free 0-50k, standard 50k-500k, pro >500k.
Sara (docs): Will update the numbers. Do we have an authoritative link for the new tier bands to point to from the sample?
Miguel (eng-ml): Use the policy doc: https://internal.redwood/infra/tiering/2026-metering (internal). For public docs, link to the public pricing page: https://redwood.ai/pricing#metering (that anchor will exist after the marketing update). I'll ping marketing to confirm the anchor.
Olivia (ux): One more: the Grafana panel link in the sample currently points to the old dashboard (grafana.redwood/old-metering). We should replace it with the new panel ID link: https://grafana.redwood/d/usage/metric-panel?panelId=9. Also add a screenshot alt text hint for accessibility.
Sara (docs): Good catch. I'll swap the link and add alt text.
Alex M: Small nit — code block language should be \`json\` not \`js\` so it highlights correctly.
Sara (docs): Will do. I'll also update the SDK snippet to call \`metering.send({ usage: ... })\` example and include a short inline example: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_123",",
  "usage": { "tokens": 120000, "feature": "generation" },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-23T15:00:00Z"
}
```
Miguel (eng-ml): That payload looks fine, just drop the stray comma after "acct_123" (typo).
Sara (docs): Fixed in the PR (I force-pushed a small patch).
deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for PR 5123 — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/5123 (build 778). :rocket:
Emily (product): Quick ask — can we also include a short migration note: "If you previously relied on X-Usage-Plan header, switch to JSON metering or X-Redwood-Usage header; SKU calculations remain unchanged." Keeps customers informed.
Sara (docs): Added a migration blurb + a one-line snippet showing both header and JSON forms.
Olivia (ux): Approved the alt text change and screenshot placeholder.
Alex M: Reviewed the code changes, LGTM aside from one l10n key for the sample caption (Sara can take).
Sara (docs): Thanks — pushed another tiny commit for the caption key. I'm aiming to merge once Miguel gives final thumbs on the payload and Emily confirms tier wording.
Miguel (eng-ml): Thumbs up from me.
Emily (product): Approved from Product.
Sara (docs): Merging in 10m unless any objections. Thanks everyone! :tada:
